newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - IPE Brent lit by bullish engulfing candl.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - IPE Brent lit by bullish engulfing candl.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
+ IPE August Brent left a bullish engulfing pattern on its daily candlestick chart on Wednesday that allows for higher prices on Thursday.
+ Daily momentum indicators also appear to have bottomed out, chartists said, and are turning higher. Significant resistance crosses at its 40-day moving average near $18.75.
IPE August Brent imprinted a bullish engulfing pattern on its daily candlestick chart on Wednesday that paves the way for further gains on Thursday, technical analysts said.

The formation occurred when a white candle "engulfed" a black candle, suggesting the downside momentum had evaporated. A white candle is made when prices open near the day's low and closes near the day's high, and the black candle is the opposite.
"This is a positive sign for the short term," said Wee Woon Whai, technical analyst at MMS International in Singapore.
She also said the daily stochastics crossed over and higher, a positive sign, and that Brent had been able to bounce higher from a roughly construed double bottom from June 11 and June 20.
Upside targets are $18.72 and $19.06, the Fibonacci 38 and 50 percent retracements of the contract's fall from $20.50 on May 16 to $17.61 on June 11, she said. Support is $17.70.
"Daily technicals are firming so it implies a firmer short-term bias," she said.
Adrian Haylor, technical analyst at Sucden in London, said August Brent could rally toward its 40-day moving average at $18.75.
"It looks like we've been holding support at around $17.60 for the best part of this month," he said. "All the momentum indicators have bottomed out and are swinging higher."
